sourceOrigin: Both trees are exact git archive extracts. Production source is byte-identical to the named commit, not a mutation or reverse patch. Root Cargo.toml workspace member list is narrowed to the three pure crates as harness setup only; tests/config are independently added outside shared checkout.

refutationAttempts.result: Refuted: baseline accepts all five invalid states; current rejects all five. The normal control remains accepted.

refutationAttempts.hypothesis: Merge-patch null is always prohibited, so deleting members does not distinguish whole-state validation.
refutationAttempts.test: Independent positive control deletes only an optional unknown extension through RFC7396 null; separate negative probe deletes required members and supplies the correct post-deletion hash.
refutationAttempts.result: Refuted: optional deletion applies in both versions. Required deletion improperly advances baseline to revision2; current rejects and preserves identical prior local state at revision1.

refutationAttempts.hypothesis: The consumer is never reached with this input because a UI/transport upstream already enforces complete SemanticState.
refutationAttempts.test: Read baseline transport JSON.parse and CharacterSyncCard event dispatch into production reduce. The reducer is the actual application receive/adoption boundary and baseline has no SemanticState validator there.
refutationAttempts.result: Refuted within the observed production receive path: CharacterSyncCard.tsx:219-220 dispatches reduce, :435 sends event.payload; transport.ts JSON parsing does not impose required SemanticState fields. Tests call that production boundary, not a mock.

refutationAttempts.hypothesis: Missing fields/null are intentional old-snapshot migration or allowed optional representation.
refutationAttempts.test: Read original 622c8bf docs/aip/character-session.md sections3 and6 and original SemanticState struct in state.rs:275-287. attention/members/reducedMotion are required, lastInteraction uses serde Option skip-if-none, and original contract says complete canonical state must contain no null.
refutationAttempts.result: Refuted for these probes. Compatibility defaults for older optional member fields do not make required top-level fields optional or authorize explicit null. The original JSONC illustration uses null but its explicit implementation note at68 and invariant at83 require omission.

refutationAttempts.hypothesis: Authoritative restore hash/deny-unknown guards already prevent raw null adoption.
refutationAttempts.test: Production CharacterSession::restore called with an independently made snapshot containing lastInteraction:null and recomputed matching hash. Controls restore a valid snapshot and reject an unknown authoritative field.
refutationAttempts.result: Refuted: both controls pass at baseline, yet explicit null is accepted and discarded, changing canonical hash. Fixed raw contains_null check rejects InvalidState before serde.

harnessIssue.description: The first current Rust attempt reused the baseline isolated target after extracting files with historical Git mtimes. Cargo reported no recompilation and executed the same baseline test artifact; that failed result is excluded from current-source verification.
harnessIssue.resolution: Use a genuinely new target-current; all three current crates recompiled and 3/0 passed. Replay script now permanently chooses a separate target by phase. No shared build target was used.

limits: Direct production boundaries with independent fixtures, not end-to-end transport or real device acceptance.
The failure severity and exploitability were not expanded; this verifies invalid-input acceptance and atomic contract enforcement only.
A non-author independently attempted refutation and authored probes; original author was not consulted for execution or expected values.
External Cargo registry cache and installed Vitest dependencies are reused read-only; production sources and build outputs are isolated.
